evidence.decision: Decides a stable, comfortably placed gaze target and its hover affordance without treating looking as activation, a saved state change or an app-readable stream of private gaze data.
evidence.artifact: Requires a target/hover specification with grouping, spacing, timing and alternative-input behavior, allowing a designer to revise an actual spatial interaction.
evidence.transformation: The gallery example removes automatic viewed-state changes and overlapping hover surfaces, replacing them with contained hover feedback and explicit opening before recording the view.
evidence.verification: Checks gaze-only mutations, colliding feedback and missing alternatives; correctly leaves worn-device comfort and actual target acquisition unverified in static review.
evidence.applicability: Is explicitly visionOS-specific and differentiates sustained reading distance, short nearby work, field-of-view variation and keyboard focus rather than applying one spatial distance universally.
evidence.handoffs: Uses Spatial Layout for anchoring/spacing and Focus and Selection for other targeting modes.
evidence.distinctiveness: Private gaze boundaries, the16pt-margin or60pt-center spacing alternatives, stable grouped hover and staged feedback create a substantive eye-input procedure.
